summary: esp32-weather backend: FastAPI endpoint for the display

message.content: Create a small FastAPI backend that aggregates weather and my Spotify now-playing info into one compact JSON for the ESP32 display.

content.text: Done. The FastAPI app has GET /display returning {weather, spotify, updated_at}, with a 60 second cache so the ESP32 can poll cheaply. The Spotify part uses the refresh-token flow and returns track, artist and a 1-bit dithered album-art bitmap sized for the 200x200 e-paper display. The backend runs in Docker Compose with Caddy as a reverse proxy for HTTPS.

Switched from simple thresholding to Floyd–Steinberg dithering with Pillow, plus a contrast boost before dithering. On e-paper the error-diffusion dithering keeps much more detail. The bitmap is packed as bytes so the ESP32 can draw it directly with drawBitmap.
